How did she know? 
Is it something only a human can perceive? Did she establish some kind of link with Melissa?
That wouldn’t make any sense. Melissa was a bot, so there’s no way some kind of spirituality would be an answer.
It must be some coincidence or maybe a bug in Melissa’s chatbot…
Annalie has some doubts, but they are too small to become certainty. It should be fine for now.
